name: aegis-ai
description: Aegis AI — Continuous AI Assurance & Governance Platform

scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:py: uv run mypy apps/api/aegis_api engines workers packages/sdk/python/aegis_ai packages/mcp/aegis_mcp
scripts.gen:types: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @aegis/types generate
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && pnpm -r --if-present format
